latestMilestone: The authenticated System Edition now also ships verified first-party GTK4 foundations for SWIR Terminal and SWIR Network Center. Terminal uses a real VTE PTY with the logged-in user's normal shell and no built-in privilege shortcut; its launch path is compatible with the VTE 0.76 GI ABI used by Ubuntu CI and the newer Debian 13 binding. Network Center performs bounded read-only NetworkManager queries through the fixed /usr/bin/nmcli path and exposes no connection mutation controls. The final integration head passed native-app Wayland, graphical-session UEFI, Live USB install and full graphical-installer E2E. The complete native daily-use application suite and physical Live USB qualification remain open.
